name: full lotus yoga pose
description: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.
